flags.-C: Provide a new comment / label for key (often email)

-f.description: Specify filename of the key file

-p.description: Change passphrase of private key file

flags.-y: Read private key file and print OpenSSH public key to stdout
flags.-R: Remove all keys belonging to hostname from known_hosts file

|.name: Pipe
|.description: Passes stdout of the left command as stdin to the right command

>.name: Redirect stdout
>.description: Redirects stdout to a file, overwriting it

>>.name: Append stdout
>>.description: Redirects stdout to a file, appending to it

2>&1.name: Merge stderr→stdout
2>&1.description: Redirects stderr to the same destination as stdout

&.name: Background
&.description: Runs the command in the background

&&.name: AND operator
&&.description: Runs the right command only if the left command succeeds (exit 0)

||.name: OR operator
||.description: Runs the right command only if the left command fails (non-zero exit)

;.name: Command separator
;.description: Runs commands sequentially regardless of exit status

&>.name: Stdout & Stderr Redirect
&>.description: Redirects both standard output (stdout) and standard error (stderr) to a file, overwriting it

>&.name: Stdout & Stderr Redirect
>&.description: Redirects both standard output (stdout) and standard error (stderr) to a file

1>.name: Stdout Redirect
1>.description: Redirects standard output (stdout) to a file, overwriting it

1>&2.name: Stdout to Stderr Redirect
1>&2.description: Redirects standard output (fd 1) into standard error (fd 2)

|&.name: Pipe Stdout & Stderr
|&.description: Pipes both standard output and standard error from the left command into stdin of the right command

<<<.name: Here-String
<<<.description: Feeds the string on the right directly into standard input (stdin) of the command

<<.name: Here-Document (Heredoc)
<<.description: Feeds multiline text stream into standard input (stdin) up to a delimiter word
